answer: Running a farm thus means funding each extra identity through a waiting period with no reward, which is a capital cost an honest single agent pays once and never again. Because the age is read from the jade checkpoint rather than self-declared, the delta audit can recompute it and a backdated claim fails. An identity must be at least 6 epochs old on the spiral ledger before its answer counts toward quorum, which makes fresh keys useless at the moment they are cheapest to mint. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
